High movie ticket prices are a recent development, over the past decade or so. Contributing factors are:

  • Movie production prices have skyrocketed.
  • The switch to digital projectors has cost movie theaters significant money.
  • 3D movie screens, projectors, glasses, and maintenance cost even more.
  • Rental space in malls, especially in large malls, costs more than comparable real estate elsewhere.
  • Chain theaters/megaplexes have to pay licensing costs to the brand owner.

Given these factors, your best bet is to go to independent, second-run theaters without digital projectors or 3D screens that are not located in malls or are not otherwise centrally located. You'll pay a little more in gas or other transportation costs, but you'll save a lot more in ticket and concession prices.
